mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an umbrella term for different approaches to text analysis that focus on systematic analysis of recursive cultural and discursive elements with which people make sense of phenomena (Nikander, 2012)."

Discourse analysis (DA) is an umbrella term for different approaches to text analysis that focus on systematic analysis of recursive cultural and discursive elements with which people make sense of phenomena (Nikander, 2012).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the use of language to describe itself or code."
The metalinguistic function refers to the use of language to describe itself or code.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a generic term used in Conversation Analysis to refer to either errors in turn taking or substantive faults in the contents of what a speaker has said (Hutchby & Wooffit, 1998)."

Error and Repair Mechanisms Repair is a generic term used in Conversation Analysis to refer to either errors in turn taking or substantive faults in the contents of what a speaker has said (Hutchby & Wooffit, 1998).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to computer mediated communication which requires participants to be online simultaneously."
Synchronous CMC refers to computer mediated communication which requires participants to be online simultaneously.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ways conversationalists link turns to each other as a coherent series of interrelated communicative actions."
Sequence organization refers to the ways conversationalists link turns to each other as a coherent series of interrelated communicative actions.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the way through which a culture unfolds in its social context; SFL researchers see text in a functional and semantic way rather than looking at sentences as formal and syntactic objects."

Text to SFL scholars is the way through which a culture unfolds in its social context; SFL researchers see text in a functional and semantic way rather than looking at sentences as formal and syntactic objects.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the textual metafunction."
The thematic system is concerned with the textual metafunction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of methods grounded in linguistic discourse analysis for mining CMD for patterns of structure and meaning."
Computer-Mediated Discourse Analysis (CMDA) is a set of methods grounded in linguistic discourse analysis for mining CMD for patterns of structure and meaning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that is typically used by people who are influenced by Marxist ideas."
Hegemony is a term that is typically used by people who are influenced by Marxist ideas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the predicate part of the clause."
The Rheme is the predicate part of the clause.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical approach to discourse study which views language and other modes of communication as social practice."
Social semiotics is a critical approach to discourse study which views language and other modes of communication as social practice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basis or the basic pattern of sequence organization."
The adjacency pair is the basis or the basic pattern of sequence organization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to how speakers format their turns to implement some action, in some position, for some recipient(s)."
A turn design refers to how speakers format their turns to implement some action, in some position, for some recipient(s).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the study of the methods which speakers/participants adopt when they organize social action through talk."
Researchers in this field are concerned with the study of the methods which speakers/participants adopt when they organize social action through talk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known for his numerous tweets."
The American president Donald Trump is known for his numerous tweets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by writers to describe generics or abstract phenomena without ever identifying them."
Exophoric reference is used by writers to describe generics or abstract phenomena without ever identifying them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a variation of the unmarked whereby focused information is foregrounded."
A marked Theme is a variation of the unmarked whereby focused information is foregrounded.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the fact that our sense of order is a as result of conversational processes which is created in talk."
Reflexivity refers to the fact that our sense of order is a as result of conversational processes which is created in talk.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with many different aspects of a society."
Political ideologies are concerned with many different aspects of a society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which the researcher has collected by themselves."
Primary data are those which the researcher has collected by themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in the classroom largely in the form of explanations, instructions, descriptions and arguments (Rezaie and Lashkarian, 2015)."
Language is used in the classroom largely in the form of explanations, instructions, descriptions and arguments (Rezaie and Lashkarian, 2015).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the contribution made by one of the participants in the discourse at a point in time."
Move A Move refers to the contribution made by one of the participants in the discourse at a point in time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the topic, participants, purpose/function, activity type, time and place in which language is used."
Context in this sense refers to the topic, participants, purpose/function, activity type, time and place in which language is used.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the utterance or part of an utterance that is perceived as problematic to at least one of the interlocutors."
The trouble source is the utterance or part of an utterance that is perceived as problematic to at least one of the interlocutors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to text creating favorable conditions for attaining the sender's goal."
Effectiveness refers to text creating favorable conditions for attaining the sender's goal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an aspect that is central to the study of conversations."
Turn- taking is an aspect that is central to the study of conversations.

Indexicality and reflexivity

conative function

Presupposition

interpersonal function

Cohesion refers to the connections which have their manifestation in the discourse itself.

unmarked Theme

theory

Solitary discourse or (monologue)

Halliday theory

Reference
